tools.name: list_patient_education
tools.title: List patient education materials
tools.description: List patient education handouts published by Dr Tamer Elalfy's surgical practice. Each entry covers one operation or diagnosis with a bilingual (English/Arabic) summary and downloadable PDF and DOCX handouts. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: get_patient_education
tools.title: Get a patient education handout
tools.description: Return the full bilingual (English/Arabic) summary and downloadable PDF/DOCX links for one patient education handout by its id. Use list_patient_education to discover ids.

tools.name: list_surgery_updates
tools.title: List recent surgery updates
tools.description: List curated recent updates in general and laparoscopic surgery published on Dr Tamer Elalfy's site. Each entry is tagged for a 'doctors' or 'patients' audience with a bilingual (English/Arabic) summary and a source link. Optionally filter by audience.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.title: Search peer-reviewed publications
tools.description: Search Dr Tamer Elalfy's peer-reviewed publications by free-text query across title, abstract, authors, and journal. Optionally filter by publication year. Returns matching entries with title, abstract, authors, journal, year, and link (DOI when available).

query.description: Free-text search across title, abstract, authors, and journal. Omit to list all publications.

year.description: Optional exact publication year filter, e.g. 2023.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20).
